arguments.question: Assess ANET’s policy and geopolitical exposure over 5, 21 and 63 sessions using the dated advanced-computing rule plus substantive issuer disclosures on geography, customers and supply. Separate revenue or geographies already excluded from management guidance from optional policy upside; evaluate export-control/licensing, supply-chain and hyperscaler/customer-concentration transmission mechanisms without assuming applicability or quantified exposure. Required deliverable: dated sourced facts, conditional channels, competing explanations, specific unquantified gaps and observable policy/company-disclosure changes that would alter the assessment. Stop after determining whether policy risk is material enough to condition the ANET thesis; do not infer current law completeness from one dated rule.
arguments.decision_impact: Determine whether geopolitical/policy channels materially constrain ANET’s business outlook or valuation and whether they belong in the final directional dependency rather than as a separate uncertainty.
